sloka: साधु रावण रामेण मां समानय दुःखिताम् ।वने वाशितया सार्धं करेण्वेव गजाधिपम् ।। ५.१९.१७।।।।
transliteration: sādhu rāvaṇa rāmeṇa māṁ samānaya duḥkhitām ।vane vāśitayā sārdhaṁ kareṇveva gajādhipam ।। 5.19.17।।।।

translations.english: Stricken with grief caused by separation from her husband, she appeared like a river gone thin and dry, not fit for ablution, like a night during dark fortnight of the month deprived of all its glow.
